== Primary documentary source and scope ==
[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement updated 29 January 2002]], page 5.
The actual 1998 preface (page 2) distinguishes most clarifying revisions from 17 gray Errata gameplay changes. Let page 82 is normal type, not a marked gray gameplay erratum; compared with the printed face, its first function spells out the globally defined equivalent "dejarik battle" (Glossary page 47). The 2002 preface (page 1) replaces same-name entries unless "See Glossary"; Let page 5 publishes the Play-on/present-with wording and is not marked as a new change in that update. These source-wording publications are preserved without manufacturing an Errata ordinal, executable state or physical printing.

The source excerpt is rendered from the actual composed page rectangle <code>[214, 654, 398, 725]</code> at 745/rectangle-width. Its image includes the following clarification paragraph; game_text contains only the published wording block, not that commentary. The 1998 complete PDF SHA-256 is <code style="overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:normal">9af0cafcd4bb8b921f5e587c8472174001319415aa4d1a3ca9a08a525ee1cfc7</code>; the 2002 complete PDF SHA-256 is <code style="overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:normal">1b1bad05cae4484a4fafae6b7ecc21e2f7697899e10a38c0f85f31f47db90c39</code>. Metadata is source-qualified: explicitly inherited verified-host uniqueness, no executable identifier, no conditional character values. Printed edition/update dates are not claimed as original first-publication days of reused wording.

== Documentary wording publication ==
The Released bound records the wording in the dated rules document: the Glossary Supplement updated 29 January 2002, page 5. The Players Committee rules-forum account states that Decipher published this document in January 2002. The month bound allows for earlier publication of the same wording; 29 January is the document’s update date. The preface’s 5 February effective date applies to marked gameplay changes, and this entry has no delta mark.<ref name="documentary-wording-publication">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, p. 5; [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1385841#p1385841 Gergall, AR Errors / Typos thread], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 18 August 2022, states that Decipher released the Supplement in January 2002.</ref> The displayed title follows the published entry heading and printed host title. The documentary article name, inherited host metadata, blank card UID, image and game text are retained.
